# Petrinaut architecture

> Generated map of the Petrinaut packages — layers, dependencies and boundaries — extracted from annotations in the source. Layers are declared next to the code they describe, so this reflects the tree as it actually is rather than as it was last documented.

Read `architecture.md` for the whole architecture in one file. Read `architecture.json` for the machine-readable model (layers, edges, boundaries, enforced rules).

## Model

- [Full architecture, single file](architecture.md): every layer with its role, boundaries, invariants and dependencies
- [Machine-readable model](architecture.json): the same data as JSON

## Generated pages

- [Architecture](pages/architecture.mdx): Generated map of the Petrinaut packages: layers, dependencies and boundaries.
- [Headless core](pages/architecture/core.mdx): SDCPN document model, compiler, simulation runtimes and LSP, with no UI framework
- [Actual mode](pages/architecture/core/actual-mode.mdx): Renders an execution supplied by an external source rather than by simulation
- [Clipboard](pages/architecture/core/clipboard.mdx): Serialises a selection and pastes it back, resolving name collisions
- [Example models](pages/architecture/core/examples.mdx): Ready-made SDCPN documents shipped for onboarding and demos
- [File format](pages/architecture/core/file-format.mdx): Reads and writes the on-disk SDCPN document format, plus export converters
- [Document handle](pages/architecture/core/handle.mdx): Stateful handle wrapping a document, emitting change events to subscribers
- [HIR compiler](pages/architecture/core/hir.mdx): Lowers user-authored TypeScript to a source-spanned IR, then typechecks, lints and emits it
- [Graph layout](pages/architecture/core/layout.mdx): Computes node positions for a net, so auto-layout does not require the canvas
- [LSP client](pages/architecture/core/lsp.mdx): Language-server client and transport for editing user code in the net
- [LSP worker](pages/architecture/core/lsp/worker.mdx): Hosts the TypeScript language server off the main thread
- [Playback](pages/architecture/core/playback.mdx): Picks the viewed frame over time and defines the per-play-mode backpressure profiles
- [Schemas](pages/architecture/core/schemas.mdx): Zod schemas for document entities, metrics and scenarios, and the descriptions the AI tools read
- [Simulation](pages/architecture/core/simulation.mdx): Executes SDCPN nets — stepping, frames, workers and batch statistics
- [User-code authoring](pages/architecture/core/simulation/authoring.mdx): Compiles and sandboxes the code users write inside a net
- [Simulation engine](pages/architecture/core/simulation/engine.mdx): Builds an SDCPN definition into a runnable instance and computes frames
- [Frames & metrics](pages/architecture/core/simulation/frames.mdx): The frame layout and the readers hosts use to inspect one frame
- [Monte Carlo runtime](pages/architecture/core/simulation/monte-carlo.mdx): Runs many independent simulations with bounded frame memory, reporting metric aggregates
- [Simulation controller](pages/architecture/core/simulation/runtime.mdx): Host-side controller for a run — owns the transport, the frame store and the status streams
- [Simulation worker](pages/architecture/core/simulation/worker.mdx): Computes simulation frames off the main thread under host backpressure
- [Readable store](pages/architecture/core/store.mdx): Minimal subscribable store primitive the core exposes instead of a framework dependency
- [Document types](pages/architecture/core/types.mdx): The canonical TypeScript types describing an SDCPN document
- [Validation](pages/architecture/core/validation.mdx): Structural integrity validators for SDCPN entities, enforcing naming conventions
- [Worker entry points](pages/architecture/core/workers.mdx): The module entry points hosts instantiate as Web Workers
- [Package surface](pages/architecture/petrinaut.mdx): The host-facing entry point: the contexts and types an embedder wires up
- [React bindings](pages/architecture/react.mdx): Contexts, hooks and providers that mirror core state into React
- [Execution frame source](pages/architecture/react/execution-frame.mdx): Abstracts where frames come from, so canvas and timeline work for live runs and recordings alike
- [Experiments provider](pages/architecture/react/experiments.mdx): Tracks Monte Carlo experiment handles and their streamed metric results
- [Shared hooks](pages/architecture/react/hooks.mdx): Cross-cutting hooks over the providers — documents, parameters, window lifecycle
- [LSP provider](pages/architecture/react/lsp.mdx): Exposes the core language client to the editor as React context
- [Playback provider](pages/architecture/react/playback.mdx): Drives the viewed frame with a requestAnimationFrame loop and applies the per-mode ack policy
- [Simulation provider](pages/architecture/react/simulation.mdx): Owns the run configuration and mirrors the core simulation handle into React
- [Editor state](pages/architecture/react/state.mdx): Contexts owning editor-session state — active net, selection, settings, undo/redo, read-only mode
- [Editor UI](pages/architecture/ui.mdx): The visual editor: canvas, panels, dialogs and the Monaco integration
- [Monaco integration](pages/architecture/ui/monaco.mdx): Wires the Monaco editor to the language server for authoring user code
- [Views](pages/architecture/ui/views.mdx): The top-level screens the editor composes — the editor shell and the net canvas
- [Canvas](pages/architecture/ui/views/canvas.mdx): Renders the net as an interactive graph, with node and arc interaction
- [Editor shell](pages/architecture/ui/views/editor.mdx): Arranges the panels, toolbars and dialogs around the canvas

## Authored pages

- [Petrinaut architecture](pages/index.mdx): How the Petrinaut packages fit together, and where to start reading.
- [Two execution paths](pages/two-execution-paths.mdx): Why Quick Simulation and Experiments share an engine but not a memory model.
- [Working on the architecture](pages/working-on-the-architecture.mdx): How to declare a layer, refine one, and what CI holds you to.

## Packages

- `@hashintel/petrinaut-core` (libs/@hashintel/petrinaut-core): Headless SDCPN engine: document model, HIR compiler, simulation runtimes, LSP. No React, no DOM.
- `@hashintel/petrinaut` (libs/@hashintel/petrinaut): React editor built on the headless core: providers, canvas, panels, Monaco integration.
